title: Booking decision
idea: Booking decision: Availability, relevant restrictions and a concise reservation summary occupy a single decision space.
audience: People who need to reserve slot within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: A time or capacity choice has important eligibility constraints.
avoidWhen: Availability is only a mock but appears bookable.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic decision layout through its reserve slot priority and explicit commitment contract: A pending request becomes confirmed only after the reservation is authoritatively created.
navigation: Booking decision keeps the current reserve slot context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Availability, relevant restrictions and a concise reservation summary occupy a single decision space.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to reserve slot; a time or capacity choice has important eligibility constraints.
composition.priority: A pending request becomes confirmed only after the reservation is authoritatively created.

imagery.role: Support the actual reserve slot context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use day then time selection with an explicit review screen and preserved timezone.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the booking decision structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no reserve slot content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; A pending request becomes confirmed only after the reservation is authoritatively created.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized reserve slot content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: A pending request becomes confirmed only after the reservation is authoritatively created.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active reserve slot context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
